name: Owner Explainer — Field Notes v1
status: experimental: specification + static still preview only; no animation renderer yet
scope: Section 3 of the owner-explainer reel only: the animated cause-and-solution explanation narrated by the owner. Opening footage, owner avatar and closing CTA are separate sections and are NOT part of this template.
reelStructure: 1 footage of a common customer problem (not this template)
2 owner avatar in a smart modern office introduces the problem (not this template)
3 THIS TEMPLATE: animated explanation of the cause and solution, narrated by the owner
4 back to the owner: 'Contact [BUSINESS NAME] to get help today' with logo and contact route (not this template)

reference.explainerSection: about 22.4 s to 62 s of 72.7 s (720x1280, 30 fps)
reference.use: visual language only; never its watermark, script, place names or artwork

businessName.note: shown in the field-notes header, e.g. '[BUSINESS] FIELD NOTES'

verifiedCause.note: must be verified by the business; never invented

customerOutcome.note: realistic, no statistics or guarantees unless the business supplies evidence

ownerNarration.note: the owner's own words; beat timings are re-fitted to the real narration

targetDurationSec.note: first test 12 to 15 s; the full section usually 30 to 40 s

palette._source: sampled from the reference frames (median of quantised pixel clusters); values are within about 3 RGB steps
_unsampled: blueStroke is estimated from the anti-aliased ring and underline edges; confirm at the visual-match review

headline.match: heavy neo-grotesque with tight tracking; the reference face is not identifiable with certainty (looks like Inter Display or a Neue Haas style grotesk)

label.match: wide-tracked uppercase header and kicker labels

annotation.match: condensed elegant italic serif used for emphasis words and notes

fonts.files: fonts/ (SIL Open Font License, Google Fonts)

headline.autoFit: lines wider than maxWidth shrink together, down to 70% of size

layout.note: camera fixed; the illustration band holds one diagram per chapter; reading time is kept on completed states
layout._measured: header, kicker and headline positions measured on the reference explainer frames scaled to 1080x1920 (header about 8% down, headline cap height about 6.5% of frame height)

motion._source: frame-by-frame inspection at 3 fps of chapters 01, 03 and 04 of the reference
motion.headlineReveal: line by line, 0.25 s per line, rising 20 px with a hard ease-out (power3.out); emphasis box wipes left to right 0.3 s BEHIND the line, then the line turns white
motion.underlineEmphasis: blue or sage under-bar wipes in left to right after the word is spoken (0.35 s)
motion.kickerAndHeader: kicker dash draws 0.2 s then text fades; header progress rule extends to n/total when the chapter starts
motion.diagramAssembly: outlines draw on (stroke-dashoffset) 0.4 to 0.8 s, then flat fills fade in 0.25 s; parts arrive in story order, never all at once
motion.causalAction: the cause moves along its path (dashed line drawing + travelling marker) synced to the narration word
motion.annotations: leader line draws first (0.25 s), then the label or italic note fades in; tags slide 12 px
motion.networks: grow outward from one seed node, links drawing to new nodes
motion.resolution: protective elements draw around the subject (ring, shield outline), fill tints in, problem markers retreat and fade, a check badge pops (scale 0.6 to 1, back.out 1.4, the only overshoot allowed)
motion.timelines: nodes tick on left to right with a sage check each
motion.chapterTransition: rare: a broad diagonal geometric wipe in sage, near-black and ochre (0.5 to 0.7 s), or a dark/olive chapter card with a large faint italic glyph and a two-line question; the card underline draws in ochre
motion.holds: every completed diagram holds at least 1.0 s; the headline exits by sliding up 40 px and fading over 0.25 s
